name: Finance-2
prompt: Premium commercial game UI concept for an original modern Korean urban life simulation called Ian Growing. Modern dense pixel art, tired ordinary protagonist, dry humor about work, education, debt, investing. Practical civic design, charcoal ink, muted blue-grey, warm uncoated paper, desaturated jade and selective oxblood seal. Group related data, stepped pixel edges, aligned numerals, restrained ink rules, explicit focus states, readable Korean. Show one finished straight-on game frame. No logos, generic mobile decoration, excessive frames, fantasy or web dashboard. Monthly household account statement with a lead cash balance and clearly differentiated debt, taxes, principal, income and recent transactions plus two unobtrusive action controls. Ink filing case with sage selection rail and a warm paper inset for the primary detail.
